recent_en: 3A's recent announcements mainly comprise multiple changes in substantial shareholder Teo Kwee Hock's interest filings from August to November 2026. On 19 August 2026, the company declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 2.1 sen per share, with ex-date on 3 September and payment date on 24 September.

Substantial shareholder Teo Kwee Hock filed multiple changes in interest between August and November 2026.
